about: raea Light's reference scenes (docs/realism.feature LT1), for `raea light check bench/light/scenes.json -o DIR`

scenes.name: gambit-street
scenes.why: its city is drawn by shader hooks the path tracer can't run and its people aren't traced (M3, M5): after LT2, LT3 and LT5
scenes.live_why: a contact sheet: every frame cuts to another view or sky, so its live frames are scene changes and its frames 0-4 are cuts, not a moving shot; gambit-walk measures both

scenes.name: gambit-walk
scenes.why: as gambit-street: the city's shader hooks and the people (M3, M5), after LT2, LT3 and LT5

scenes.name: kitchen
scenes.why: its daylight is RectLight panels (the window, the court's sky, a bounce panel), which neither Solari nor the path tracer draws (M9), and its hands are skinned (M3): after LT5b and LT5

scenes.name: glade
scenes.live_why: raea play runs a file's first composition, and v3/film.tsx's isn't the wide shot
